🧠 Healthcare
MI HB 6400 — Michigan Could Bar Some Workers From Mental Health Facilities

This bill would change how psychiatric facilities and other healthcare facilities hire staff. It says a facility can't hire someone with a history of certain serious crimes – including violent felonies, abuse, or crimes involving prescription drugs – unless 10 years have passed since they completed their sentence, parole, and probation. ...
